title: Uplifting Lower-Income Data: Strategies for Socioeconomic Perspective Shifts in Large Multi-modal Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot image retrieval recall on the Dollar Street dataset across four household income groups (poor, low-mid, up-mid, rich) using default English prompts versus prompts with socioeconomic attributes.
Comparing image retrieval performance disparities across data from 63 different countries and 4 continents using baseline prompts versus prompts appended with geographic country suffixes.
Measuring image retrieval recall differences between default English text prompts and prompts translated into 40 major non-English languages.
